question: What was our net revenue for each clinic in Q3 2026?
sql:
SELECT c.clinic_nm, SUM(i.tot_amt_c) AS net_revenue
FROM clinic c
JOIN appt a ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
JOIN inv_hdr i ON a.appt_id = i.appt_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', i.inv_dt) BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06'
GROUP BY c.clinic_nm
why: showed clinics outside the West region: CL-04, CL-05, CL-06 (POL-ROW-03)
